metadata.holdout_policy: The final holdout is removed before feature/label generation; no model scoring, threshold selection or risk sizing uses it.
metadata.hypothesis_warning: The hybrid long/short pairing was inspired by previously observed development OOS side attribution. This run is discovery research, not independent validation.
metadata.selection: top 10% calibrated TP probability per side; at most one entry per 96 bars

fee_schedule_bps.source: configurable assumptions; verify personal rates in Binance account

metadata.primary_costs: Taker entry; TP exit Maker conditional on passive limit fill; SL and TIME exits Taker; round-trip slippage included
metadata.stress_costs: Taker entry and Taker exit for every exit reason; round-trip slippage included
metadata.legacy_comparison: Maker entry and Maker exit for all trades; optimistic baseline only
metadata.maker_fill_warning: 15m OHLC does not prove passive queue execution or Maker fill at TP; all-Taker scenario must also remain viable
